Lemma
[Compact embedding] Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0194 1. ch8:8.5\group ch08-generalized-solutions For $\Hcal =W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )$, the map $I:\Hcal \to \Hcal ^*$ defined by \begin{equation} Iu(v)=\int _\Omega uv\, dx \tag {8.12} \end{equation} is compact.
Proof

\sketch Factor $I$ through the compact embedding $W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )\hookrightarrow L^2(\Omega )$ and the continuous map $L^2(\Omega )\to W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )^*$ induced by the $L^2$ pairing.

□

Define $L_\sigma =L-\sigma $. For a coercive shift $\sigma _0$, the zero-boundary equation is equivalently \begin{equation} u+\sigma _0L_{\sigma _0}^{-1}Iu=L_{\sigma _0}^{-1}F. \tag {8.13} \end{equation} The formal adjoint is \begin{equation} L^*u=D_i(a^{ij}D_ju-c^iu)-b^iD_iu+du. \tag {8.14} \end{equation}
